result.instructions: Runs commands and file operations on this host. Prefer exec (argv, no shell) over exec_shell (pipes, redirects, shell syntax). For long-running or interactive processes: exec_start, then exec_poll; always exec_close, sessions persist across requests. Auth: X-Node-Token header or Authorization: Bearer.
